kicker: Field report: an audit trail for a farm-credit co-op
headline: Every loan decision, traceable to its evidence.
lede: A copilot proposes a credit decision with the evidence beside it; an officer approves; the ledger remembers. The diagram reads bottom to top; the ledger below lists the figures, their sources, and what has not been measured.
data_statement: The co-op and its members are fictional. The loan records are synthetic; the rainfall series is real public data. This is a hackathon prototype, not a production system.

problem.title: Decisions nobody could explain
problem.body: Credit decisions lived in spreadsheets and phone calls. When a loan was questioned months later, nobody could say what the officer had seen.

response.title: A copilot that shows its evidence
response.body: The assistant proposes a decision and lists the records behind each figure. An officer decides. The decision and its evidence are stored together.

capabilities.title: Evidence beside every figure
capabilities.body: Each number in an answer links to the record and rule that produced it.

capabilities.title: A second pair of eyes
capabilities.body: Large loans need two officers; the assistant has no approve action.

platform.title: How it runs
platform.intro: The services that carry each step, strongest first.
